notes.title: Bug Fixes - v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Small update to fix a couple of issues:

[list]
[*] Some sounds are too loud when distance drop-off should kick in.
[*] When force-exiting on leaderboards, leaderboards will linger afterwards.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Some sounds are too loud when distance drop-off should kick in.
[*] When force-exiting on leaderboards, leaderboards will linger afterwards.
